heading: Server Hard Disk
bottomHtml:
Server hard disks, also known as enterprise HDDs, are designed to deliver high performance, reliability, and 24/7 operation for demanding business environments. These drives are specifically built for data centers, servers, NAS, and RAID systems, ensuring consistent performance under heavy workloads.


Unlike standard desktop hard drives, server HDDs feature advanced technologies such as higher workload rates, enhanced vibration tolerance, error correction, and longer lifespan. They are available in SATA and SAS interfaces, with SAS drives offering faster data transfer speeds and better reliability for enterprise applications.


Enterprise hard drives typically operate at 7200 RPM or higher, providing faster data access and improved efficiency for mission-critical operations. With capacities ranging from 1TB to 20TB+, server HDDs are ideal for handling large-scale storage needs such as databases, virtualization, cloud storage, and backup systems.
